entities.summary: Nilton Pacheco de Oliveira, commonly known as Nilton Pacheco, was a Brazilian basketball player who competed in the 1948 Summer Olympics in London, United Kingdom. There he won the bronze medal with the men's national basketball team under the guidance of head coach Moacyr Daiuto. He was born in Salvador, Bahia.
